siteSettings.title: Virtual Hospitals Africa
siteSettings.description:
Virtual Hospitals Africa is a non-profit addressing a critical healthcare gap in rural Africa, where diagnoses are delayed by infrequent doctor visits and costly travel.

Our telemedicine platform transforms local clinics into hubs of continuous care by connecting healthcare workers to global specialists for 24/7 remote consultations. 

We help frontline workers detect risks early and keep patient records updated. The system enables high-quality care in resource-limited settings, working offline, in local languages, and on any device.

Virtual Hospitals Africa is building a future where no patient is out of reach.
